visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with long, dark wavy hair, wearing a dark red vest with intricate gold and black embroidery over a dark shirt, speaks directly to the camera. Her facial expressions are animated and friendly as she explains a religious topic. The setting is a bright studio with light-colored wooden slat walls. On the left, a small bonsai-like plant sits on a decorative wooden stand. Vertical text banners in white and red are overlaid on the right side, and horizontal white subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The visual transitions to a sequence of detailed and colorful Thangka illustrations depicting various Buddhist deities. The central figure is a white, multi-armed deity seated on a lotus throne, surrounded by a blue aura and smaller figures in various colors like blue, red, and green. The camera pans slowly across the artwork, revealing the intricate patterns of the flowers and symbolic objects held by the figures. The background of the artwork features stylized clouds and a deep blue sky. (3) The shot cuts back to the woman in the studio setting. She continues her presentation, occasionally using small hand gestures to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her face and the textures of her clothing. The background remains consistent with the wooden slats and the small plant on the left. White horizontal subtitles continue to scroll at the bottom of the screen, providing a transcription of her speech. (4) A static graphic screen replaces the video feed, featuring a white background with gold decorative borders. It displays several circular profile pictures of the woman and her brand logos for Facebook, Instagram, and LINE. At the top, a prominent red warning label about fraud is visible. The layout is organized, showing official account names like 'Yu Young' and verification checkmarks. It also includes sections for the official apps in Taiwan and Malaysia. (5) A final informational graphic is shown, divided into green and blue sections. It provides specific contact details, including a LINE QR code area and a WhatsApp number for Malaysia (+60-178123889). Two small portrait photos of the woman are positioned at the bottom, labeled for Taiwan and Malaysia regions. The screen serves as a directory for official customer service and social media channels, maintaining a clean and professional appearance.
